summary.en: Chief of the Ashina Türks, Bumin opened relations with the Western Wei, crushed the Tiele and then his Rouran overlords, and proclaimed himself Il-Qaghan in 552, dying the same year; his brother Istämi extended Turkic rule west.
summary.zh: 阿史那突厥首领土门与西魏通好，先击败铁勒，再推翻宗主柔然，于552年自立为伊利可汗，同年去世；其弟室点密向西扩展了突厥的统治。

label.en: Western Wei envoy reaches the Türks in the Altai
label.zh: 西魏使者抵达阿尔泰的突厥

label.en: Receives a Western Wei princess (envoys to Chang’an)
label.zh: 迎娶西魏公主（遣使长安）

sources.title: Linghu Defen et al., Zhoushu, ch. 50: the Tujue
Peter B. Golden, An Introduction to the History of the Turkic Peoples (1992)

note: Birth year unknown; 490 follows Wikidata and is not attested in the sources. Locations are approximate.

summary.en: Temüjin rose from an outcast childhood to unite the steppe tribes in 1206, reorganised them into decimal military units under a law code, and launched conquests of the Jin, Western Xia and Khwarazm that began the largest contiguous land empire in history.
summary.zh: 铁木真幼年孤苦，后于1206年统一草原诸部，以十进制军事组织和札撒法令加以整编，并发动对金、西夏和花剌子模的征服，开创了历史上疆域最大的连续陆地帝国。

label.en: Born near the Onon river (Delüün Boldog)
label.zh: 生于斡难河畔（迭里温孛勒答黑）

label.en: Proclaimed Genghis Khan at the Onon source
label.zh: 在斡难河源称成吉思汗
自讹答剌入侵花剌子模

label.en: Defeats Jalal al-Din on the Indus
Dies during the Western Xia campaign

sources.title: The Secret History of the Mongols, tr. Igor de Rachewiltz (2004)
Ata-Malik Juvaini, Tarikh-i Jahangushay (The History of the World-Conqueror), tr. J. A. Boyle (1958)

note: Birth year is disputed (1155, 1162 or 1167); 1162 follows Wikidata and most modern accounts. Place of death is approximate.

story.en:
Temüjin was about nine when, according to the Secret History, his father Yesügei was poisoned by Tatars, and the clan abandoned his mother Hö’elün and her children to survive on roots and fish along the Onon. The Secret History tells how the boy killed his half-brother Begter in a quarrel over food, was captured by the Tayichi’ud and escaped with a wooden cangue on his neck, and built a following one ally at a time.

His rise depended on alliances that he later broke: with Ong Khan of the Kereits, his father’s blood brother, and with his own sworn brother Jamukha. After defeating both, and the Naimans, he was acclaimed Chinggis Khan in 1206. He promoted men for loyalty and ability rather than birth, and his generals Jebe and Subutai were commoners.

From 1211 he attacked the Jin, from 1219 Khwarazm, and he died in 1227 during his final campaign against the Western Xia. His burial place was kept secret and has never been found. The empire his sons and grandsons built reached from Korea to Hungary.
story.zh:
据《蒙古秘史》，铁木真约九岁时，父亲也速该被塔塔儿人毒死，族人抛弃了他的母亲诃额仑和孩子们，他们只能在斡难河边靠挖草根、捕鱼为生。《蒙古秘史》记载，少年铁木真因争食射杀了异母兄弟别克帖儿，又被泰赤乌人擒获，戴着木枷逃脱，此后一个盟友一个盟友地积聚起追随者。

他的崛起依靠一些后来被他亲手打破的联盟：与其父的安答、克烈部的王汗，与他自己的安答札木合。击败二人及乃蛮部之后，他于1206年被拥立为成吉思汗。他按忠诚与才能而非出身提拔人才，大将哲别和速不台都出身平民。

1211年起他进攻金朝，1219年起进攻花剌子模，1227年在最后一次征伐西夏的途中去世。他的葬地一直保密，至今未被发现。由他的子孙建立的帝国，疆域从朝鲜半岛延伸到匈牙利。

summary.en: A Uriankhai commoner who became Genghis Khan’s foremost general, Subutai led the great raid around the Caspian to the Kalka, helped destroy the Jin dynasty, and planned the invasion of Rus’ and Hungary under Batu.
summary.zh: 速不台出身兀良哈平民，成为成吉思汗麾下最杰出的将领，曾率军绕里海远袭至迦勒迦河，参与灭金，并在拔都统帅下策划了征服罗斯和匈牙利的西征。

label.zh: 追击摩诃末二世穿越呼罗珊
匈牙利赛约河之战获胜

sources.title: Yuanshi (History of Yuan), chs. 121–122: biographies of Subutai
Carl Sverdrup, The Mongol Conquests: The Military Operations of Genghis Khan and Sübe’etei (2017)

role.en: Second Great Khan of the Mongol Empire

summary.en: Third son and chosen heir of Genghis Khan, Ögedei completed the conquest of the Jin, built a walled capital at Karakorum, set up a postal relay system and sent armies into Europe, Iran and Korea before his death in 1241.
summary.zh: 成吉思汗第三子及指定继承人，窝阔台完成灭金，在哈拉和林修筑都城，建立驿站制度，并派兵进攻欧洲、伊朗和高丽，1241年去世。

label.en: Elected Great Khan on the Kherlen
label.zh: 在克鲁伦河畔被推举为大汗

sources.title: The Secret History of the Mongols, tr. Igor de Rachewiltz (2004)
Ata-Malik Juvaini, Tarikh-i Jahangushay (The History of the World-Conqueror), tr. J. A. Boyle (1958)

role.en: Great Khan; founder of the Yuan dynasty

summary.en: Grandson of Genghis Khan, Kublai defeated his brother Ariq Böke for the throne, moved the imperial centre from Karakorum to China, proclaimed the Yuan dynasty in 1271 and completed the conquest of the Southern Song.
summary.zh: 成吉思汗之孙，忽必烈击败其弟阿里不哥夺得汗位，将帝国重心从哈拉和林移至汉地，1271年建国号“大元”，并完成对南宋的征服。

sources.title: Morris Rossabi, Khubilai Khan: His Life and Times (1988)
Song Lian et al., Yuanshi (History of Yuan), chs. 4–17

summary.en: Sent west by his brother Möngke, Hulagu destroyed the Nizari Ismaili fortresses, sacked Baghdad and executed the last Abbasid caliph in 1258, and founded the Ilkhanate in Iran, though his advance into Syria was checked at Ain Jalut.
summary.zh: 旭烈兀受其兄蒙哥派遣西征，摧毁尼查里伊斯玛仪派诸堡，于1258年攻陷巴格达、处死末代阿拔斯哈里发，并在伊朗建立伊儿汗国，但其向叙利亚的推进在艾因贾鲁特受阻。

label.en: Leaves Mongolia on the western campaign
Defeated by Berke on the Terek
label.zh: 在捷列克河败于别儿哥

sources.title: Rashid al-Din, Jami al-Tawarikh (tr. W. M. Thackston)
Timothy May, The Mongol Conquests in World History (2012)

summary.en: A Barlas Turkic emir from near Kesh, Timur seized Transoxiana in 1370 and in ceaseless campaigns ravaged Iran, the Golden Horde, India and Anatolia while making Samarkand a showpiece capital; he died marching on Ming China.
summary.zh: 帖木儿是渴石附近巴鲁剌思部的突厥埃米尔，1370年夺取河中，此后连年征战，蹂躏伊朗、金帐汗国、印度和安纳托利亚，同时将撒马尔罕营建为壮丽的都城；他在进军明朝途中去世。

label.zh: 生于渴石（沙赫里萨布兹）附近
在捷列克河击败脱脱迷失
在安卡拉击败巴耶济德一世
在撒马尔罕接见克拉维约

label.en: Dies at Otrar marching on China
label.zh: 进军中国途中卒于讹答剌

sources.title: Beatrice Forbes Manz, The Rise and Rule of Tamerlane (1989)

story.en:
Timur was born, traditionally in 1336 though many contemporary sources suggest the late 1320s, into a minor family of the Turkicised Mongol Barlas tribe near Kesh, south of Samarkand. As a young raider he was wounded by arrows in the right leg and arm, which left him lame; Persian enemies called him Timur-i Lang, “Timur the Lame”, which Europeans turned into Tamerlane. Soviet anthropologists who opened his tomb in 1941 confirmed the injuries.

He never took the title of khan, which belonged to Genghis Khan’s descendants. Instead he ruled through puppet khans as amir and güregen, “royal son-in-law”, after marrying a Chinggisid princess. From 1370 until his death he was almost always at war, breaking the Golden Horde, sacking Delhi and Damascus, and capturing the Ottoman sultan Bayezid at Ankara. Contemporary chroniclers describe towers built of the skulls of massacred townspeople.

At home he brought the craftsmen of conquered cities to build Samarkand. The Castilian envoy Clavijo found him old and nearly blind in 1404, but still planning a war on China. He died at Otrar the next February.
story.zh:
帖木儿生于撒马尔罕以南渴石附近（传统说法为1336年，但不少当时的史料表明是在1320年代后期），出身于突厥化蒙古巴鲁剌思部的一个小家族。年轻时在劫掠中右腿和右臂中箭，落下跛足；波斯敌人称他为“跛子帖木儿”（Timur-i Lang），欧洲人讹为“Tamerlane”。1941年苏联人类学家开启其墓室，证实了这些伤痕。

他从未自称可汗，因为这一称号属于成吉思汗的后裔。他娶了一位黄金家族公主，以“埃米尔”和“驸马”（古列干）身份通过傀儡可汗进行统治。从1370年直到去世，他几乎一直在征战：击溃金帐汗国，洗劫德里和大马士革，在安卡拉俘虏奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德。当时的史家记载他用被屠城民的头颅垒成高塔。

在本土，他把被征服城市的工匠带回来建设撒马尔罕。1404年卡斯蒂利亚使节克拉维约见到他时，他已年老、几近失明，却仍在筹划远征中国。次年二月他死于讹答剌。

role.zh: 帖木儿王朝君主、天文学家

summary.en: Grandson of Timur, Ulugh Beg governed Samarkand for four decades, turning it into a centre of science with his madrasa and observatory; his star catalogue was unrivalled for accuracy, but he was murdered soon after becoming supreme ruler.
summary.zh: 帖木儿之孙，兀鲁伯治理撒马尔罕近四十年，以其经学院和天文台使之成为科学中心；其星表精度在当时无与伦比，但他成为最高统治者后不久即遭杀害。

label.en: Succeeds Shah Rukh as head of the dynasty
Killed on his son’s orders near Samarkand
label.zh: 在撒马尔罕附近被其子下令杀害

sources.title: Aydın Sayılı, The Observatory in Islam (1960)
Beatrice Forbes Manz, The Rise and Rule of Tamerlane (1989)

summary.en: Born in Khwarazm, al-Biruni wrote on astronomy, geodesy, mineralogy and chronology, measured the Earth’s radius from a mountain in the Punjab, and after years at Ghazni produced a pioneering study of Indian religion and science.
summary.zh: 比鲁尼生于花剌子模，著述涉及天文、测地、矿物和年代学，曾在旁遮普的山上测算地球半径；在伽色尼多年后写成开创性的印度宗教与科学研究著作。

label.en: Gurgan: The Chronology of Ancient Nations
label.zh: 在古尔干写成《古代民族编年史》
被马哈茂德带往伽色尼

label.en: Measures the Earth at Nandana, Punjab
label.zh: 在旁遮普南达纳测量地球

label.en: Completes his book on India (Tahqiq ma li-l-Hind)

sources.title: Al-Biruni, Alberuni’s India, tr. Edward C. Sachau (1888)
S. Frederick Starr, Lost Enlightenment: Central Asia’s Golden Age from the Arab Conquest to Tamerlane (2013)

note: The Nandana measurement is undated in his text; 1025 is an approximation.

summary.en: Known as the “Second Teacher” after Aristotle, al-Farabi harmonised Greek logic and political philosophy with Islamic thought and wrote a major treatise on music; he worked in Baghdad and later at the Hamdanid court.
summary.zh: 法拉比被誉为继亚里士多德之后的“第二导师”，他将希腊逻辑与政治哲学同伊斯兰思想相融合，并著有重要的音乐论著；曾在巴格达治学，后入哈姆丹王朝宫廷。

label.en: Born, probably at Farab (Otrar) on the Syr Darya
label.zh: 可能生于锡尔河畔的法拉布（讹答剌）

label.en: Moves to Aleppo and the Hamdanid court
label.zh: 迁往阿勒颇，入哈姆丹宫廷

sources.title: Muhsin Mahdi, Alfarabi and the Foundation of Islamic Political Philosophy (2001)
S. Frederick Starr, Lost Enlightenment: Central Asia’s Golden Age from the Arab Conquest to Tamerlane (2013)

note: Birthplace is disputed between Farab on the Syr Darya and Faryab in Khurasan; Kazakhstan claims him as a native son. Stop years are approximate.

summary.en: Boyhood friend and minister of the Timurid sultan Husayn Bayqara, Nava’i made Chagatai Turkic a great literary language through his five-part Khamsa and his treatise comparing Turkic and Persian, and endowed many buildings in Herat.
summary.zh: 纳沃伊是帖木儿王朝苏丹侯赛因·拜哈拉的少年好友和重臣，他以《五卷诗》和比较突厥语与波斯语的论著使察合台突厥语成为伟大的文学语言，并在赫拉特捐建了众多建筑。

label.en: Keeper of the seal under Husayn Bayqara
label.zh: 在侯赛因·拜哈拉治下掌玺
出任阿斯特拉巴德总督

sources.title: Maria E. Subtelny, “Ali Shir Nava’i: Bakhshi and Beg”, Harvard Ukrainian Studies 3–4 (1979–80)

note: Dates of individual works are approximate.

role.en: Khan of the Kazakh Middle Horde

summary.en: A warrior-sultan of the Middle Horde, Ablai led Kazakh resistance to the Dzungars, balanced Russia and Qing China after the Dzungar collapse, and was proclaimed khan of all three hordes at Turkistan in 1771.
summary.zh: 阿布赉是中玉兹的武士苏丹，领导哈萨克人抵抗准噶尔，在准噶尔灭亡后周旋于俄国与清朝之间，1771年在突厥斯坦被推举为三玉兹共主。

label.zh: 出生（传统说法在突厥斯坦附近）

label.en: Swears allegiance to Russia at Orenburg
label.zh: 在奥伦堡宣誓效忠俄国

label.en: Held captive by the Dzungars at Ghulja
Accepts Qing suzerainty after the Dzungar collapse
label.zh: 准噶尔覆灭后归附清朝
在突厥斯坦被推举为汗

label.en: Dies; buried at the Yasawi mausoleum

sources.title: Martha Brill Olcott, The Kazakhs, 2nd ed. (1995)
Peter C. Perdue, China Marches West (2005)

note: Birth year and place are traditional; he died near Tashkent per some accounts.

role.en: Founder of the Shaybanid Uzbek state
role.zh: 昔班尼乌兹别克国家创建者

summary.en: Grandson of Abu’l-Khayr, Shaybani led the Uzbeks south from the Qipchaq steppe, took Samarkand from the Timurids, drove out Babur and captured Herat, before being killed by Shah Ismail I near Merv.
summary.zh: 阿布海尔之孙，昔班尼率乌兹别克人从钦察草原南下，从帖木儿王朝手中夺取撒马尔罕，逐走巴布尔并攻陷赫拉特，后在梅尔夫附近被萨法维国王伊斯玛仪一世击杀。

label.zh: 在萨里普勒击败巴布尔
征服花剌子模（乌尔根奇）

label.en: Killed by Shah Ismail near Merv
label.zh: 在梅尔夫附近被伊斯玛仪国王击杀

summary.en: Born in Panjrud near Panjakent, Rudaki became court poet of the Samanid amir Nasr II in Bukhara and is regarded as the father of New Persian poetry. Only fragments of his vast output survive; late in life he lost royal favour and died in his native village.
summary.zh: 鲁达基生于片治肯特附近的潘杰鲁德，成为布哈拉萨曼王朝埃米尔纳斯尔二世的宫廷诗人，被誉为新波斯诗歌之父。他的大量作品仅有片段存世；晚年失宠，卒于故乡。

label.zh: 生于片治肯特附近的潘杰鲁德

label.en: Court poet of Nasr II at Bukhara
label.zh: 在布哈拉任纳斯尔二世的宫廷诗人

note: Birth year c. 858–859; the date of his fall from favour (c. 937) is approximate. Panjrud stops use Panjakent coordinates.

story.en:
Abu Abdallah Rudaki was born in the village of Panjrud in the Zeravshan valley. Later biographers say he was blind, perhaps from birth, though some scholars think he was blinded later; the Soviet anthropologist Mikhail Gerasimov, who studied his remains in the 1950s, concluded that he had been blinded as an adult. He became the favourite poet of the young Samanid amir Nasr II in Bukhara and grew rich at court.

His most famous poem was written, according to the story told by Nizami Aruzi, when the amir had lingered for years at his summer camp in Herat and his homesick courtiers begged Rudaki to make him return. Rudaki sang of the scent of the river Muliyan and the warm sands of the Amu Darya, and Nasr was so moved that he leapt on his horse without his boots and rode for Bukhara.

Medieval writers credited him with more than 180,000 verses; only about a thousand couplets survive. Writing in the new Persian of the Samanid court rather than Arabic, he helped found the literature that leads to Ferdowsi, Hafez and Rumi.
story.zh:
阿布·阿卜杜拉·鲁达基生于泽拉夫尚河谷的潘杰鲁德村。后世传记说他是盲人，也许生来如此，但也有学者认为他是后来失明的；苏联人类学家格拉西莫夫在1950年代研究其遗骨后，认为他是成年后被人致盲的。他成为萨曼王朝年轻的埃米尔纳斯尔二世最宠爱的诗人，在布哈拉宫廷中积累了巨富。

据内扎米·阿鲁兹记载，他最著名的一首诗写于埃米尔在赫拉特夏营流连数年不归之时，思乡的廷臣们恳请鲁达基劝他回去。鲁达基吟唱穆利扬河的芬芳和阿姆河温暖的沙滩，纳斯尔深受感动，连靴子都没穿就跃上马背奔回布哈拉。

中世纪作家称他作诗逾十八万句，如今仅存约一千联。他用萨曼宫廷的新波斯语而非阿拉伯语写作，为通向菲尔多西、哈菲兹和鲁米的波斯文学奠定了基础。

role.en: Han general and Protector General of the Western Regions

summary.en: Brother of the historian Ban Gu, Ban Chao spent three decades in the Tarim Basin, winning the oasis kingdoms back from the Xiongnu with small forces and local allies, and sent the first Chinese envoy towards Rome.
summary.zh: 史学家班固之弟班超在塔里木盆地经营三十年，以少量兵力和当地盟友从匈奴手中夺回各绿洲王国，并派出第一位前往罗马方向的中国使者。

label.en: Copyist in Luoyang; “throws down his brush”
label.zh: 在洛阳为官府抄书，投笔从戎

label.en: Takes Shule (Kashgar), his base for years

sources.title: Fan Ye, Hou Hanshu, ch. 47: Biography of Ban Chao
Rafe de Crespigny, A Biographical Dictionary of Later Han to the Three Kingdoms (2007)

note: The 62 CE stop is approximate; the Hou Hanshu places his clerkship in Luoyang after his brother’s appointment there.

role.en: Counsellor and general of the Second Turkic Khaganate

summary.en: Educated in China, Tonyukuk joined Ilterish’s revolt against the Tang in 682 and served three khagans as strategist, leading campaigns against the Kyrgyz and Türgesh. His own memorial inscription is one of the oldest Turkic texts.
summary.zh: 暾欲谷曾在中国受教育，682年参加骨咄禄（颉跌利施可汗）反唐起事，先后辅佐三位可汗，率军征讨黠戛斯和突骑施。他本人的纪功碑是现存最古老的突厥文献之一。

label.en: Serves in the Tang protectorate for the Türks
label.zh: 在唐朝单于都护府任职

label.en: Joins Ilterish’s revolt in the Yinshan
label.zh: 在阴山加入骨咄禄起事

label.en: Moves the khaganate’s centre to Ötüken
label.zh: 将汗国中心迁至于都斤山

label.en: Leads a winter march over the Sayan against the Kyrgyz
label.zh: 冬季翻越萨彦岭讨伐黠戛斯

label.en: Buried at Bain Tsokto, where his inscription stands
label.zh: 葬于巴音楚克图，纪功碑立于此

sources.title: Talat Tekin, A Grammar of Orkhon Turkic (1968), with the Tonyukuk inscription
Peter B. Golden, An Introduction to the History of the Turkic Peoples (1992)

note: His birth and death years are approximate (c. 646 – c. 724/726). He is often identified with Ashide Yuanzhen of the Chinese sources. Locations are approximate.

story.en:
Tonyukuk tells his own story in the inscription he had carved on two stones in the Tuul valley, the earliest Turkic autobiography. He says he grew up “in the land of the Tabgach”, the Chinese, when the Türks were Tang subjects, and that the Turkic people were then without a khan.

In 682 he joined Ilterish, who had gathered a few hundred followers in the Yinshan mountains, and became his chief adviser. He persuaded the new khagan to move to the sacred Ötüken uplands, and in the reigns of Ilterish, Qapaghan and Bilge he planned many campaigns. The most famous was a winter march against the Kyrgyz: Tonyukuk says the army climbed the snowy Kögmen mountains on foot, leading their horses, and fell on the enemy while they slept.

Chinese sources record an old Tonyukuk warning Bilge Qaghan not to build walled cities or Buddhist temples, because the Türks’ strength lay in moving with their herds while the Chinese could besiege any city. His inscription ends with a proud claim: had he not lived and worked so hard, there would have been no Turkic people.
story.zh:
暾欲谷在土拉河谷两块石碑上亲自讲述了自己的一生，这是最早的突厥人自传。他说自己生长于“桃花石”（中国）之地，当时突厥人是唐朝属民，没有自己的可汗。

682年，他投奔在阴山聚集了数百名追随者的骨咄禄，成为其首席谋臣。他劝说新可汗迁往神圣的于都斤山，并在骨咄禄、默啜和毗伽三位可汗在位期间策划了许多战役。最著名的是一次讨伐黠戛斯的冬季远征：暾欲谷记述大军牵着马徒步翻越积雪的曲漫山，趁敌人熟睡时发起突袭。

中国史料记载，年迈的暾欲谷曾劝谏毗伽可汗不要修筑城池和佛寺，因为突厥人的力量在于随畜群迁徙，而唐人可以围攻任何城池。他的碑文以一句自豪的话结尾：倘若没有他和他的辛劳，就不会有突厥人民。

role.en: Khagan of the Second Turkic Khaganate

summary.en: Raised to the throne in 716 by his brother Kül Tegin, Bilge Qaghan restored the Türk khaganate after Qapaghan’s defeats, made peace with the Tang and in 732 set up the Orkhon memorial to Kül Tegin. He was poisoned by one of his officials; his own inscribed stele was raised after his death.
summary.zh: 毗伽可汗于716年由其弟阙特勤拥立，在默啜可汗屡遭败绩之后重振突厥汗国，与唐朝议和，并于732年在鄂尔浑河畔为阙特勤立碑。他后被一名大臣毒死，其本人的碑铭在他死后竖立。

label.en: Enthroned at Ötüken after Kül Tegin’s coup
label.zh: 阙特勤发动政变后于于都斤山即位
在北庭附近击败拔悉密

label.en: Raises the memorial to Kül Tegin on the Orkhon
label.zh: 在鄂尔浑河畔为阙特勤立碑

sources.title: Orkhon inscriptions (Kül Tegin and Bilge Qaghan steles)
Ouyang Xiu et al., Xin Tangshu, ch. 215: Tujue

note: Stop locations are approximate.

summary.en: Inheriting a Yarlung chiefdom, Songtsen Gampo united the Tibetan plateau, moved his court to Lhasa, married princesses from Nepal and Tang China, and is credited with introducing writing and Buddhism; later Tibetans revered him as an emanation of Avalokiteshvara.
summary.zh: 松赞干布继承雅砻部落首领之位，统一青藏高原，将王廷迁至拉萨，迎娶尼泊尔和唐朝的公主，相传创制文字并引入佛教；后世藏人尊其为观世音菩萨的化身。

label.en: Succeeds his murdered father in the Yarlung valley
label.zh: 父亲被害后在雅砻河谷继位

label.en: Attacks Songzhou on the Tang frontier
Dies; buried in the royal tombs at Chongye

sources.title: Brandon Dotson, The Old Tibetan Annals (2009)

note: His birth year is uncertain (569, 605 and 617 are also given); the stops follow the Old Tibetan Annals and Chinese records. The Songzhou attack was led by his armies; his personal presence is not certain.

role.en: Emperor of Tibet and patron of Buddhism

summary.en: Under Trisong Detsen the Tibetan Empire reached its height, briefly occupying Chang’an in 763, while at home he invited Indian masters, founded Samye and declared Buddhism the state religion.
summary.zh: 赤松德赞在位时吐蕃国力达到鼎盛，763年一度占领长安；在国内他延请印度高僧，创建桑耶寺，并宣布佛教为国教。

sources.title: Sam van Schaik, Tibet: A History (2011)

note: His death is dated 797, 800 or 804 in different sources; 797 follows Wikidata. Drakmar, near Samye, is approximately located.

summary.en: Sent to govern Bukhara by his brother, Ismail ibn Ahmad defeated him, united Transoxiana, beat back Turkic nomads from the steppe and destroyed Saffarid power at Balkh in 900. Tajikistan honours him as the founder of the first Tajik state.
summary.zh: 伊斯玛仪·伊本·艾哈迈德受兄长派遣治理布哈拉，后击败兄长，统一河中，击退草原突厥游牧民，并于900年在巴尔赫摧毁萨法尔王朝的势力。塔吉克斯坦尊其为第一个塔吉克国家的缔造者。

label.en: Defeats his brother Nasr near Bukhara
label.zh: 在布哈拉附近击败兄长纳斯尔

label.en: Takes Talas and turns its church into a mosque
label.zh: 攻取怛逻斯，改其教堂为清真寺

label.en: Captures Amr ibn al-Layth near Balkh
label.zh: 在巴尔赫附近俘获阿穆尔·伊本·莱斯

label.en: Dies; buried in the Samanid mausoleum, Bukhara
label.zh: 去世，葬于布哈拉萨曼王陵

sources.title: Narshakhi, The History of Bukhara, tr. R. N. Frye (1954)
Encyclopaedia Iranica: Khorasan vi. History in the Taherid and Samanid Periods

note: Whether the mausoleum was built for Ismail or his father is debated.

summary.en: Son of a Turkic slave general, Mahmud made Ghazni the capital of an empire from Iran to the Punjab and led some seventeen plundering campaigns into India, including the sack of Somnath. Poets such as Unsuri served at his court, Ferdowsi presented the Shahnameh to him, and al-Biruni was brought to Ghazni after the conquest of Khwarazm.
summary.zh: 马哈茂德是一位突厥奴隶出身将领之子，以伽色尼为都建立了从伊朗到旁遮普的帝国，曾约十七次远征印度劫掠，包括洗劫索姆纳特。昂苏里等诗人供职于其宫廷，菲尔多西把《列王纪》献给他，比鲁尼则在花剌子模被征服后被带到伽色尼。

label.zh: 任呼罗珊总督，驻内沙布尔

label.en: Defeats the Hindu Shahi king Jayapala near Peshawar
label.zh: 在白沙瓦附近击败印度沙希王贾亚帕拉
从布韦希王朝手中夺取赖伊

summary.en: A Karakhanid prince turned scholar, Mahmud al-Kashgari travelled among the Turkic tribes and in Baghdad wrote the Diwan Lughat al-Turk, the first dictionary and ethnography of the Turkic peoples, with its famous round world map.
summary.zh: 麻赫穆德·喀什噶里出身喀喇汗王族，后成为学者，他游历突厥各部，在巴格达撰写了《突厥语大词典》，这是第一部突厥语词典和突厥民族志，附有著名的圆形世界地图。

label.en: Born at Barskhan by Lake Issyk-Kul
label.zh: 生于伊塞克湖畔的巴尔斯汗

label.en: Leaves Kashgar after a dynastic upheaval
label.zh: 王室变乱后离开喀什噶尔
在巴格达撰写《突厥语大词典》

label.en: Dies at Opal near Kashgar, where his tomb stands
label.zh: 卒于喀什附近的乌帕尔，陵墓在此

sources.title: Mahmud al-Kashgari, Compendium of the Turkic Dialects, ed. and tr. R. Dankoff & J. Kelly (1982–85)
Peter B. Golden, An Introduction to the History of the Turkic Peoples (1992)

note: His dates are uncertain; 1029–1101 follows Wikidata, while 1005–1102 is also given. The years of leaving Kashgar and of his return are conjectural.

role.en: Founder of the Qara Khitai (Western Liao)

summary.en: A Khitan prince and scholar of the Liao court, Yelü Dashi refused to submit to the Jurchen conquerors, led a band of followers west across Mongolia, took the title Gurkhan and built the Qara Khitai empire in Central Asia, crushing the Seljuks at Qatwan in 1141.
summary.zh: 耶律大石是辽朝宗室和进士出身的学者，他拒绝向女真征服者投降，率部众西越蒙古高原，号称“菊儿汗”，在中亚建立西辽帝国，并于1141年在卡特万大败塞尔柱人。

label.en: Leads his followers west to Kedun on the Orkhon
label.zh: 率部西至鄂尔浑河畔的可敦城
在叶密立附近称菊儿汗
在卡特万击败苏丹桑贾尔

sources.title: Michal Biran, The Empire of the Qara Khitai in Eurasian History (2005)

note: The date of his proclamation as Gurkhan is given as 1124 or 1132 in different sources.

summary.en: Son of Muhammad II, Jalal al-Din fought the Mongols from Afghanistan to the Indus, escaped to India, then carved out a new realm in Iran and the Caucasus before he was defeated and killed while a fugitive in Anatolia.
summary.zh: 札兰丁是摩诃末二世之子，从阿富汗到印度河一路抗击蒙古人，逃往印度后又在伊朗和高加索建立新的统治，最终兵败，流亡安纳托利亚时被杀。

label.en: Swims the Indus after his defeat

label.zh: 夺取大不里士和阿塞拜疆
在埃尔津詹附近的亚瑟切门战败

label.en: Killed in the mountains near Mayyafariqin
label.zh: 在迈亚法里京附近山中被杀

sources.title: Ata-Malik Juvaini, History of the World-Conqueror, tr. J. A. Boyle (1958)

note: The place of his death is reported variously by the chroniclers.

summary.en: Son of Jochi, Batu commanded the western campaign of 1236–42 that conquered the Rus’ principalities and invaded Hungary, then ruled the western steppe from Sarai as senior prince of the Mongol family and kingmaker in Möngke’s election.
summary.zh: 拔都是术赤之子，统率1236—1242年西征，征服罗斯诸公国并入侵匈牙利，随后以萨莱为中心统治西部草原，作为黄金家族长辈宗王在蒙哥当选大汗中起了决定作用。

label.en: Settles on the lower Volga; founds Sarai
label.zh: 定居伏尔加河下游，建萨莱

sources.title: Peter Jackson, The Mongols and the West, 1221–1410 (2005)

note: His birth year is approximate; Sarai’s foundation is dated variously to the 1240s or 1250s.

role.en: Fourth Great Khan of the Mongol Empire

summary.en: Eldest son of Tolui and Sorghaghtani Beki, Möngke was elected Great Khan in 1251 with Batu’s backing, purged the rival Ögedeid line, reformed taxes and the census, sent Hulagu to Iran and Kublai to China, and died besieging a Song fortress.
summary.zh: 蒙哥是拖雷与唆鲁禾帖尼的长子，1251年在拔都支持下当选大汗，清洗窝阔台系对手，改革赋税和户口制度，派旭烈兀西征伊朗、忽必烈经营中国，在围攻南宋城堡时去世。

label.en: Besieges the Alan capital in the Caucasus
label.zh: 围攻高加索阿兰人都城

label.en: Before Kyiv during the western campaign
Elected Great Khan on the Kherlen
label.zh: 在怯绿连河畔当选大汗

label.en: Holds court at Karakorum; receives Rubruck
label.zh: 在哈拉和林临朝，接见鲁布鲁克
围攻四川钓鱼城时去世

sources.title: Thomas T. Allsen, Mongol Imperialism: The Policies of the Grand Qan Möngke (1987)

note: His death is attributed to dysentery or a wound; the Chinese and Persian sources differ.

role.zh: 方济各会传教士、旅行家

summary.en: A Flemish friar sent informally by Louis IX of France, William of Rubruck crossed the steppe in 1253–55 to the courts of Batu and Möngke; his report, the most vivid Western account of the Mongols, noted that Cathay was the land of the Seres and described Karakorum.
summary.zh: 佛兰德修士鲁布鲁克受法王路易九世非正式派遣，1253—1255年穿越草原拜访拔都和蒙哥的宫廷；他的报告是西方关于蒙古人最生动的记述，指出契丹即古代的“赛里斯”，并描写了哈拉和林。

label.en: Lands at Soldaia in the Crimea
label.zh: 在克里米亚的苏达克登陆

label.en: At Batu’s camp on the Volga
label.zh: 抵达伏尔加河畔拔都营地

label.en: At Karakorum; the debate of religions
label.zh: 在哈拉和林参加宗教辩论

label.en: Back in Tripoli, writes his report
label.zh: 回到的黎波里，撰写报告

sources.title: William of Rubruck, The Mission of Friar William of Rubruck, tr. P. Jackson & D. Morgan (1990)
Britannica: Willem van Ruysbroeck (William of Rubruck)

note: His birth and death years are approximate (c. 1220 – c. 1293).

summary.en: A Jochid prince raised to power with Timur’s help, Tokhtamysh reunited the Golden Horde, defeated Mamai and burned Moscow in 1382, but then fought his patron and was crushed by him in 1391 and 1395; he died a fugitive in Siberia.
summary.zh: 脱脱迷失是一位借帖木儿之助上台的术赤系宗王，他重新统一金帐汗国，击败马麦，并于1382年焚毁莫斯科，但随后与恩主反目，1391年和1395年两度被帖木儿击溃，最后在西伯利亚流亡中死去。

label.en: Takes refuge with Timur at Samarkand
label.zh: 投奔撒马尔罕的帖木儿

label.en: Defeated by Timur on the Kondurcha
label.zh: 在昆都尔察河败于帖木儿
在秦吉图拉（秋明）附近被杀

sources.title: Beatrice Forbes Manz, The Rise and Rule of Tamerlane (1989)

note: His birth year is unknown (1342 follows Wikidata); the place of his death is uncertain.

role.en: Timurid queen and patron of architecture
role.zh: 帖木儿王朝王后、建筑赞助者

summary.en: Chief wife of Shah Rukh and mother of Ulugh Beg, Gawhar Shad wielded great political power at the Timurid court of Herat and paid for the great mosque at Mashhad and the Musalla complex in Herat. She was executed at about eighty after a succession struggle.
summary.zh: 高哈尔·沙德是沙哈鲁的正妻、兀鲁伯之母，在赫拉特的帖木儿宫廷中握有很大政治权力，出资兴建了马什哈德的大清真寺和赫拉特的穆萨拉建筑群。在一场继承之争后，她于约八十岁时被处死。

label.en: Moves to Herat with Shah Rukh’s court
label.zh: 随沙哈鲁宫廷迁居赫拉特
开始兴建穆萨拉建筑群

label.en: With Shah Rukh when he dies near Rayy
label.zh: 沙哈鲁死于赖伊附近时随侍在侧

label.en: Executed at Herat on Abu Sa‘id’s orders
label.zh: 在赫拉特被阿布·赛义德下令处死

sources.title: Lisa Golombek & Donald Wilber, The Timurid Architecture of Iran and Turan (1988)
Beatrice Forbes Manz, Power, Politics and Religion in Timurid Iran (2007)

note: Her birth year is approximate.

role.en: Founder of the Gelug school of Tibetan Buddhism
role.zh: 藏传佛教格鲁派创始人

summary.en: Born in Amdo, Tsongkhapa Lobsang Drakpa studied with teachers of every Tibetan school and wrote the Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path. His insistence on monastic discipline and study founded the Gelug school, whose leaders became the Dalai and Panchen Lamas.
summary.zh: 宗喀巴·罗桑扎巴生于安多，师从藏传佛教各派上师，著有《菩提道次第广论》。他强调戒律与闻思，创立格鲁派，该派领袖后来成为达赖喇嘛和班禅喇嘛。

label.en: Born at Tsongkha in Amdo (later Kumbum)
label.zh: 生于安多宗喀（后来的塔尔寺所在地）

label.en: Arrives in central Tibet to study
Completes the Lamrim Chenmo at Reting
label.zh: 在热振寺完成《菩提道次第广论》

label.en: Founds the Great Prayer Festival at the Jokhang
label.zh: 在大昭寺创立传召大法会

sources.title: Thupten Jinpa, Tsongkhapa: A Buddha in the Land of Snows (2019)

summary.en: Grandson of Dayan Khan, Altan Khan raided Ming China for decades, besieging Beijing in 1550, then made peace in 1571, founded the city of Kökeqota (Hohhot) and, by meeting Sonam Gyatso in 1578, brought Gelug Buddhism to the Mongols.
summary.zh: 俺答汗是达延汗之孙，数十年间不断袭扰明朝，1550年兵临北京，1571年与明朝议和，兴建归化城（呼和浩特），并于1578年会见索南嘉措，把格鲁派佛教传入蒙古。

label.en: Leads the Tümed on the Hohhot plain
label.zh: 统领呼和浩特平原上的土默特部

label.en: Peace with the Ming; made Prince Shunyi
label.zh: 与明朝议和，受封顺义王
兴建库库和屯（呼和浩特）
在青海湖附近会见索南嘉措

note: The 1542 and 1571 stops are approximate.

role.en: Dalai Lama and ruler of Tibet

summary.en: Ngawang Lobsang Gyatso, “the Great Fifth”, became ruler of Tibet in 1642 with the help of the Khoshut Mongols, built the Potala, visited the Qing court in 1652–53 and wrote prolifically on history and religion.
summary.zh: 阿旺罗桑嘉措被尊称为“伟大的五世”，1642年在和硕特蒙古帮助下成为西藏统治者，修建布达拉宫，1652—1653年赴清廷觐见，并在历史和宗教方面著述宏富。

label.en: Born at Chingwa Taktse in Chongye
Made ruler of Tibet at Shigatse
label.zh: 在日喀则成为西藏统治者

label.en: Received by the Shunzhi emperor in Beijing
Dies at the Potala; death kept secret
label.zh: 圆寂于布达拉宫，死讯被秘而不宣

sources.title: Sam van Schaik, Tibet: A History (2011)
Samten G. Karmay, The Illusive Play: The Autobiography of the Fifth Dalai Lama (2014)

role.en: First Jebtsundamba Khutugtu, sculptor and scholar
role.zh: 一世哲布尊丹巴呼图克图、雕塑家、学者

summary.en: A son of the Tüsheet Khan recognised as a reincarnate lama in childhood, Zanabazar became the spiritual head of the Khalkha Mongols, created the Soyombo script, cast gilt-bronze Buddhist sculptures of famous beauty, and led his people into the Qing empire in 1691.
summary.zh: 扎那巴扎尔是土谢图汗之子，幼年被认定为转世喇嘛，后成为喀尔喀蒙古的宗教领袖，创制索永布文字，铸造了以精美著称的鎏金铜佛像，并于1691年带领喀尔喀人归附清朝。

label.en: Born in Khalkha, son of the Tüsheet Khan
label.zh: 生于喀尔喀，土谢图汗之子

label.en: Proclaimed head of Khalkha Buddhism; his camp, Örgöö, is founded
label.zh: 被推为喀尔喀佛教领袖，其驻地“乌尔格”建立

label.en: Studies in Tibet with the Fifth Dalai Lama
label.zh: 赴西藏随五世达赖喇嘛学法

label.en: Submits to the Kangxi emperor at Dolon Nor
label.zh: 在多伦诺尔归附康熙帝

sources.title: Charles R. Bawden, The Modern History of Mongolia (1968)
Patricia Berger & Terese Tse Bartholomew, Mongolia: The Legacy of Chinggis Khan (1995)

note: Early stops in Khalkha are approximate.

story.en:
Zanabazar was born in 1635 to Gombodorj, the Tüsheet Khan of Khalkha, a descendant of Genghis Khan. As a small boy he was recognised as the reincarnation of the Tibetan scholar Taranatha, and in 1639 the Khalkha nobles proclaimed him their spiritual leader. His mobile monastery camp, Örgöö, would eventually settle on the Tuul and grow into Ulaanbaatar.

He went to Tibet as a teenager to study with the Fifth Dalai Lama and the Panchen Lama, and returned with Tibetan artists and a new lineage title, Jebtsundamba. Zanabazar himself became the greatest sculptor of Mongolia. His gilt-bronze figures of Tara and the Buddhas of the five directions, cast in his workshop, are prized for their serene faces and supple bodies. In 1686 he devised the Soyombo script for writing Mongolian, Tibetan and Sanskrit; its opening symbol is now on Mongolia’s flag.

When Galdan’s Dzungars overran Khalkha in 1688, Zanabazar led the decision to seek Qing protection. He spent much of his later life at the Kangxi emperor’s court and died in Beijing in 1723. His body was returned to Mongolia.
story.zh:
扎那巴扎尔1635年生于喀尔喀土谢图汗衮布多尔济之家，是成吉思汗的后裔。他幼年时被认定为藏族学者多罗那他的转世，1639年喀尔喀贵族推举他为宗教领袖。他的移动寺院营地“乌尔格”后来定居土拉河畔，发展成为乌兰巴托。

少年时他赴西藏随五世达赖喇嘛和班禅喇嘛学法，回来时带着西藏工匠和新的转世名号“哲布尊丹巴”。扎那巴扎尔本人成为蒙古最伟大的雕塑家，他作坊中铸造的鎏金铜度母像和五方佛像，以宁静的面容和柔美的身姿著称。1686年他创制了用于书写蒙古文、藏文和梵文的索永布文字，其起首符号如今出现在蒙古国国旗上。

1688年噶尔丹的准噶尔军队席卷喀尔喀时，扎那巴扎尔主导了寻求清朝保护的决定。他晚年大部分时间住在康熙帝的宫廷中，1723年卒于北京，遗体被运回蒙古。

summary.en: A cavalry commander of Nader Shah, Ahmad Khan Abdali was chosen king by the Pashtun chiefs at Kandahar in 1747 and built an empire from Khurasan to the Punjab and Kashmir, invading India repeatedly and defeating the Marathas at Panipat in 1761.
summary.zh: 艾哈迈德汗·阿布达里原是纳迪尔沙的骑兵统领，1747年在坎大哈被普什图首领们推举为王，建立了从呼罗珊到旁遮普和克什米尔的帝国，多次入侵印度，并于1761年在帕尼帕特击败马拉塔人。

label.zh: 在坎大哈附近被推举为王

label.en: First invasion of India; takes Lahore
label.zh: 首次入侵印度，攻占拉合尔

summary.en: Founder of the Barakzai dynasty, Dost Mohammad took Kabul in 1826, was driven out by the British invasion of 1839 and exiled to India, but returned in 1843 and reunited most of Afghanistan, taking Herat just before his death.

summary.en: A Kokandi officer who had defended Ak-Mechet against the Russians, Yaqub Beg came to Kashgar in 1865 amid the Muslim revolts against the Qing and made himself master of the Tarim Basin and Turfan, winning recognition from the Ottomans, Russia and Britain before the Qing reconquest.
summary.zh: 阿古柏是浩罕军官，曾坚守阿克梅切季抵抗俄军。1865年他趁新疆穆斯林反清起事来到喀什噶尔，成为塔里木盆地和吐鲁番的统治者，在清军收复新疆之前曾得到奥斯曼、俄国和英国的承认。

summary.en: Son of a clan chief in the Chingiz hills, Abai founded modern Kazakh written literature with his lyric poems, his translations of Pushkin, Lermontov and Krylov, and his prose Book of Words, which urged Kazakhs to pursue learning and moral reform.
summary.zh: 阿拜是成吉思山区一位氏族首领之子，以抒情诗、翻译普希金、莱蒙托夫和克雷洛夫的作品以及散文《箴言录》奠定了现代哈萨克书面文学，劝勉哈萨克人追求知识和道德革新。

label.en: Studies at a madrasa in Semipalatinsk
label.zh: 在塞米巴拉金斯克的经学院学习

label.en: Translates Pushkin’s Eugene Onegin into Kazakh
label.zh: 把普希金的《叶甫盖尼·奥涅金》译为哈萨克文

label.en: Dies at Zhidebai in the Chingiz hills
label.zh: 卒于成吉思山区的日德拜

sources.title: Martha Brill Olcott, The Kazakhs (2nd ed., 1995)

note: Locations in the Chingiz hills are approximate; the translations date from the late 1880s.

story.en:
Abai, born Ibrahim, grew up in the camps of his father Qunanbai, a powerful and severe chief in the Chingiz hills south of Semipalatinsk. He was sent to a madrasa in the town, where he read Persian and Arabic poetry, and in his twenties he began to meet Russian political exiles who introduced him to Russian literature.

He spent much of his life as a clan leader and judge in a steppe changing under Russian rule, and his poems are often bitter about what he saw: quarrels over posts in the new volost elections, laziness, flattery and ignorance. In the 1880s he translated Pushkin’s Tatyana’s letter from Eugene Onegin and set it to music; it became a popular song across the steppe. In his prose Book of Words, forty-five short reflections written in his last fifteen years, he urged Kazakhs to learn Russian and the sciences without abandoning their faith and conscience.

His later years were darkened by the death of his son and by feuds. He died in 1904. In the Soviet period Mukhtar Auezov made his life the subject of a great novel, The Path of Abai, and Semipalatinsk’s region is now named after him.
story.zh:
阿拜本名易卜拉欣，在父亲库南拜的营地中长大，父亲是塞米巴拉金斯克以南成吉思山区一位强势而严厉的首领。他被送进城里的经学院，在那里阅读波斯语和阿拉伯语诗歌；二十多岁时他开始结识俄国政治流放者，后者把他引入俄罗斯文学。

他一生大部分时间在俄国统治下不断变化的草原上担任氏族首领和调解人，他的诗歌常常尖锐地批评所见所闻：新设乡长选举中的争权夺利、懒惰、谄媚和愚昧。1880年代，他翻译了普希金《叶甫盖尼·奥涅金》中达吉雅娜的信并为之谱曲，成为风靡草原的歌曲。在晚年十五年间写成的散文《箴言录》四十五篇中，他劝勉哈萨克人学习俄语和科学，同时不放弃信仰与良知。

他晚年因儿子早逝和家族纷争而郁郁寡欢，1904年去世。苏联时期，穆赫塔尔·阿乌埃佐夫以他的一生为题材写成长篇巨著《阿拜之路》，塞米巴拉金斯克所在的州如今以他的名字命名。

role.en: Dalai Lama and ruler of Tibet

summary.en: Thubten Gyatso fled the British invasion of 1904 to Mongolia and the Qing invasion of 1910 to India, then returned in 1913 to rule Tibet as a de facto independent state, trying to build a modern army and administration against monastic opposition.
summary.zh: 土登嘉措1904年为躲避英国入侵出走蒙古，1910年为躲避清军入藏出走印度，1913年返回后把西藏作为事实上独立的国家来治理，在寺院势力的反对下尝试建立现代军队和行政体系。

Returns to Lhasa and issues his proclamation

note: The 1913 proclamation is regarded by Tibetans as a declaration of independence; China has not accepted that reading.

role.en: Eighth Jebtsundamba Khutugtu and ruler of Mongolia
role.zh: 第八世哲布尊丹巴呼图克图、蒙古统治者

summary.en: Born in Tibet and brought to Urga as a child, the Eighth Jebtsundamba was the head of Mongolian Buddhism and in 1911 became Bogd Khan of independent Mongolia, reigning through Chinese occupation, the White Russian interlude and the revolution until his death.
summary.zh: 第八世哲布尊丹巴生于西藏，幼年被迎至库伦，是蒙古佛教领袖，1911年成为独立蒙古的博克多汗，历经中国军队占领、白俄插曲和革命，在位直至去世。

label.en: Installed at Urga as the Jebtsundamba
label.zh: 在库伦坐床为哲布尊丹巴

label.en: Kept as limited monarch after the revolution
label.zh: 革命后保留为有限君主

sources.title: Charles R. Bawden, The Modern History of Mongolia (1968)

summary.en: A soldier of the autonomous Mongolian army, Sükhbaatar helped found the Mongolian People’s Party in 1920, led its partisan army with Soviet support against the Chinese and Ungern’s Whites in 1921, and died two years later; the capital’s central square bears his name.
summary.zh: 苏赫巴托尔原是自治蒙古军队的士兵，1920年参与创建蒙古人民党，1921年在苏俄支持下率领游击队对抗中国军队和恩琴的白军，两年后去世；首都中心广场以他的名字命名。

name.zh: 努尔苏丹·纳扎尔巴耶夫

summary.en: A steelworker turned party official, Nazarbayev led Soviet Kazakhstan from 1989 and independent Kazakhstan until 2019. He gave up the inherited Soviet nuclear arsenal, closed the Semipalatinsk test site, moved the capital to Astana and presided over oil-driven growth, ruling through elections that observers judged unfree. The January 2022 unrest ended his remaining power.
summary.zh: 纳扎尔巴耶夫由钢铁工人出身成为党政官员，1989年起领导苏维埃哈萨克斯坦，并任独立后的哈萨克斯坦总统直至2019年。他放弃继承的苏联核武库，关闭塞米巴拉金斯克核试验场，迁都阿斯塔纳，主导了以石油带动的经济增长，而他赖以执政的历次选举被观察员认为不自由。2022年1月的骚乱终结了他残余的权力。
